# Synapse 2.0.16

A new workflow that runs the one open on screen is built as a new workflow, Synapse AI reads web pages with its own web reader instead of looking for an outside service, a search right after adding a file says the file is still being indexed, and a condition that fails on a blank form field says which field.

## Fixed

- **A new workflow that runs the open one is built new.** With a workflow open, asking Synapse AI to "make a workflow that runs my Refund Approval workflow for a sample refund" planned it as a change to the open workflow. A request for a new workflow that runs, calls or starts after the open one now builds a new workflow, and a change to the open one that names it stays a change.
- **Synapse AI reads web pages itself.** Asked to read a web page and save what it says, Synapse AI looked for outside browser services, said nothing here could do it, and ended with words written for a booking. It now plans the workflow with its own web reader, or with a browser agent for a page behind a login when a browser is installed. A question about a page is still answered, anything it cannot do here is looked up as before, and the closing line fits any request.
- **A search right after adding a file says the file is still indexing.** A workflow that added a file to a knowledge base and searched it moments later said "No passages matched", and its next step told you the document did not say. It now says which knowledge base is still indexing, how many documents, and to run it again shortly. An agent's knowledge search says the same.
- **A condition that fails on a blank field names the field.** A form sent with a field left blank made a later If/Else or Switch stop with "'>' not supported between instances of 'NoneType' and 'int'". It now says which value was empty and to fill it in, or to have the condition say what an empty value means. Any other failure says what it said before.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.16`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.
